result.title: Beyond Feature Fusion: Sensor-Grounded Semantic-Spiking Learning for Robust Object Detection
result.summary: Underexposure weakens object details, and overexposure obscures boundaries. Spike cameras encode light into high-frequency binary streams. Long-window spike counts give stable appearance cues, while short observations reveal changes in firing rates from sparse measurements. We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework for illumination-robust object detection from a single spike stream. SPIRE builds an appearance view from the full packet through detection-oriented illumination adaptation and constructs a sequence of cumulative views from progressively longer prefixes. Each prefix supplies a rate map, an edge map, and a rate difference that tracks changes as spikes accumulate. At selected scales, ANN features and spike-derived initialization jointly set the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds, allowing semantic cues to shape the responses during temporal encoding. Local spike-count contrasts supervise both branches during training. The residual between measured and ANN-predicted contrasts combines with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused feature pyramid. On simulated VOC and COCO, SPIRE-D outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.00-5.50 AP50 points across the four under- and overexposure settings. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS recordings, it achieves 67.07 AP50 and 40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D also uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPIRE，一种基于单路 spike 流的高动态范围目标检测框架：用全包数据构建外观视图，并按递增前缀生成累积视图与 rate/edge/差分图，以 ANN 特征与脉冲统计共同设定膜电位和阈值，再将实测与 ANN 预测对比度的残差作为有界校正注入融合特征金字塔。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以「预测—实测对比度残差」做有界校正、用视觉证据初始化内部状态的机制，可供核查 LVR 中视觉旁路是否真正被使用、内部状态如何吸收视觉细节，但该文面向检测工程，与推理流程关系较远。
